metadata.method_name: Site-specific random displacement in Qwen3-8B, W16A16 rerun of the iteration-4 site study

s_a.rule: per task, among S0/S4 x alpha 1/2/4 cells with pass >= 0.8 x twin, the largest correct off-default share (ties: lower alpha, then S0); comparators S1, S2, S5 at the same alpha; exact McNemar on shared slots; Holm over 6; PASS iff on both tasks every diff >= 0.15 and Holm p < 0.05; robust iff the selection-aware Holm (6p) also passes; DISCONFIRMED iff on both tasks at every gated dose max(S0,S4) - max(S1,S5) < 0.05
s_a.n_shared_note: primary uses every shared slot (N 50 where the P6(b) top-ups ran, else N 30)

f2.note: same-seed rows of exp21/exp27 ran on FP8 with top-k 10; top-k only lowers p_alt, so the bound is conservative; cross-engine caveat

deviations.what: NVIDIA L4 (22 GiB usable, compute 8.9) instead of the planned RTX A4500 20 GB
deviations.consequence: W16A16 kept (VRAM >= 19.5 GiB); no CPU embedding offload needed

deviations.what: fixed batch shape B = 16 (T03/T10) and 12 (T2/T1) instead of the plan's starting 8/6
deviations.why: memory probe at full length passed with peak 18.6/22.0 GiB (results/batch_probe.json); larger B halves GPU time
deviations.consequence: B frozen in src/cfg.py before commit #1; U1 batch-composition invariance verified at B = 16

deviations.what: U3: mean along-u displacement equals alpha x unit within 0.05% at every prefill site, but the max per-position relative error is 0.58-0.87% for S4, S5 and TOP5 (threshold 0.5%)
deviations.why: the edit is exact in fp32; casting the edited residual to bf16 rounds every component (relative 2^-9); at S4 the displacement is only 1-6% of ||h||, so that rounding is up to ~0.9% of the displacement
deviations.consequence: not a hook bug (alpha-0 identity U2 and the positive control U8 pass); reported, sampling proceeds

deviations.what: U4 shadow fidelity: T10 min cos 0.9998 (pass), T03 min cos 0.69 over 19 steps (fail)
deviations.why: the same pattern as exp20 in FP8 (T03 0.68, T1 0.996), diagnosed there as decode-path vs full-forward numerics rather than the shadow coupling
deviations.consequence: S3's along-u target vs its shadow holds within 0.04% (U3) and S3 alpha 0 is byte-identical to the twin (U2); reported

deviations.what: F2 q_lik / thinking-on passes run AFTER the decisive sampling instead of in Step 5
deviations.why: GPU queue order: they do not feed any committed set or direction
deviations.consequence: prediction (v) and the F2 rule are committed before m is computed (stricter than the plan)

deviations.what: the committed banned sets use earlier twin rows (exp19/24/27), not this artifact's twin
deviations.why: this artifact's twin is a decisive cell sampled after commit #1
deviations.consequence: results/banned_sets_check.json re-derives the sets with this twin added

deviations.what: T1 masked forced prompts (exp22) cover exp8's 6 modes (astar_gbfs, dijkstra names), not the 10-algorithm extended catalogue
deviations.why: exp22 built T1 masked prompts on the exp8 catalogue
deviations.consequence: T1 centroids and push directions use the 300 named prompts; masked T1 points are shown, not used for centroids

deviations.what: U9 (twin vs earlier bf16 twin rows) is computed post hoc from the P1 twin rows
deviations.why: the twin rows are decisive rows sampled after commit #1

deviations.what: push progress t = <s_push - s_twin, v>/<c_S - s_twin, v> is unstable when the twin is not on the banned side of v (T03 top-3 gives t = -83 at alpha 1)
deviations.why: the twin prompt (a ban-shaped neutral sentence) sits off the forced-prompt manifold
deviations.consequence: t is reported as committed; a second normalisation <s_push - s_twin, v>/||c_S - c_B|| is reported beside it (descriptive)

deviations.why: needed only for the descriptive S3-vs-matched-decoding KL table
deviations.consequence: hash in inputs/SHA256SUMS_post_commit1; no committed rule uses it

deviations.what: src/geometry.py changed between commit #1 and commit #2: vectorised k-NN graph and separability; MDS initialised at the classical-MDS solution with one SMACOF run instead of 8 random inits
deviations.why: the committed version took 11 min per S-d pass on 5 CPU cores shared with the GPU job
deviations.consequence: S-d is descriptive; CPU tests T6 re-verify the geometry (half-ring stress 0.0004); commit #2 records the new hash

deviations.what: three fixes to src/analysis.py after commit #2 (recorded in commit #3): (1) the S-d extended-survivor count on T1 used the K=7 label, under which every extended survivor maps to other; it now uses label_ext (the edge test already did); (2) m_fork dropped forks at the first code token, although both continuations share the prompt and fence line there; now included; (3) the stable push-progress normalisation t-prime was added beside the committed t (descriptive)
deviations.why: bugs found on reading the first full outputs
deviations.consequence: S-a, S-b, S-c, F1 and the F2 primary m are unaffected

deviations.what: F2 margin undefined on R3, R6, T04, T05, T06 and T08 (the default or the runner-up has fewer than 3 test-passing adherent forced programs; T06 hash_set supplemented with one label-verified non-adherent program)
deviations.why: the plan fallback (generate up to 15 forced programs with vLLM) was not run for time
deviations.consequence: q_lik reported for every algorithm with >= 3 programs; m defined on 9 of 15 tasks including all F2-decisive tasks (T2, T03, T1)

deviations.what: the ban-free / iteration-4 ban unit ratio is 0.81 (ratio of means) and 1.00 (mean of per-position ratios) on T03 blocks 12-23, not exp27 unit_ratio.json 1.39
deviations.why: exp27 averaged its per-row ratio against exp17 FP8 norms with its own prompt/position set; not reconciled here
deviations.consequence: descriptive only; no rule uses the ratio

deviations.what: src/cfg.py (DEP_DATASET default) and src/figures.py (house-style path) rewritten to environment variables after the run
deviations.why: published files must not hold absolute server paths
deviations.consequence: no computation changed; recorded as commit 5

extrapolation.rule: time only, never outcome; plan drop order

costs.note: labelling judges (paths, K=7, bench) + novelty-audit judges incl. 6 controls x 3 judges; artifact cap USD 0.50
